fixed_assets_cost_ck.name: fixed_assets_cost_ck
fixed_assets_cost_ck.value: cost > 0 and residual_value >= 0 and residual_value < cost

companies_select.name: companies_select
companies_select.using:
id = current_company_id() or exists (
        select 1 from company_members m
        where m.company_id = companies.id
          and m.user_id = current_app_user_id()
          and m.status = 'active')

companies_insert.name: companies_insert
companies_insert.withCheck: current_app_user_id() is not null and id = current_company_id()

journal_lines_foreign_ck.name: journal_lines_foreign_ck
journal_lines_foreign_ck.value: (currency is null) = (foreign_amount is null) and (exchange_rate is null or currency is not null) and (currency is null or currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$') and (exchange_rate is null or exchange_rate > 0)

audit_logs_insert.name: audit_logs_insert
audit_logs_insert.withCheck: company_id is null or company_id = current_company_id()

auto_journal_rules_amount_ck.name: auto_journal_rules_amount_ck
auto_journal_rules_amount_ck.value: min_amount is null or max_amount is null or min_amount <= max_amount
